metadata.title: Spirewatch | TRON-Inspired Ambient Music for Focus
metadata.scope: Published YouTube mix, 02:00–32:00; includes any baked SFX. Not an isolated music master.

method.spectrum: Hann-window stereo power, 8192 samples / 50% overlap, resampled 48 kHz
method.ffmpeg_version: ffmpeg version 7.1-essentials_build-www.gyan.dev Copyright (c) 2000-2024 the FFmpeg developers

limitations: Signal measurements only; no assistant listening or instrument/vocal identification.
Spectral energy percentages are not perceived loudness percentages.
RMS is an unweighted level measure; LUFS/LRA/true peak are measured separately by FFmpeg.
Recurrence suggests similar patterns, not proven loops; stationary drones can look repetitive.
Change markers identify places to audition, not confirmed musical transitions.
Analysis cannot establish why a listener enjoys a track or predict retention/CTR.
